# Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `project-rules/INDEX.md`, and `docs/AI_WORKING_GUIDE.md` before making project changes. Also inspect `skills/INDEX.md` and use relevant skills. Fixed rules are normative; the guide is canonical technical context.

For target status and open findings, consult `docs/mcu-port-project-workbook.md` and `docs/platformio-mcu-compatibility.md`.

You may freely create, revise, combine, and use skills. Store every project skill at `skills/<lowercase-kebab-name>/SKILL.md` and update the index in the same change. Skills cannot override project rules.
